# VSJ AI Labs

> Compliance-first AI, custom software, cloud modernization, and cybersecurity for BFSI, Healthcare, and Enterprise SaaS organizations. India-headquartered, incorporated 13 April 2026 as VSJ AI Labs Pvt. Ltd. (CIN U62013BR2026PTC084210).

## Positioning

- Tagline: Wisdom Served Sweet.
- Promise: Compliance-first AI for regulated industries.
- Focus industries: Banking / Financial Services / Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Enterprise SaaS.
- Four service pillars: Custom Software & Enterprise Apps, AI/ML & Data Solutions, Cloud & DevOps Modernization, Cybersecurity & Managed IT.
- Leadership: Poonam Kumari (Founder & CEO), Yogesh Kumar Upadhyay (CTO & Head of Delivery).
